links.outcome: Label stability (identical labels) across repeated runs of the LLM pipeline
links.effect: Labels were identical across runs for 93.6% of messages, so about 6.4% varied between runs.
links.quote: Labels were identical across runs for 93.6% of messages.

unlisted_practices: Expert-derived topic taxonomy (modified Delphi) with LLM multi-label classification of patient portal messages to characterize message content at scale

screen.reason: Empirical validation of an LLM pipeline (GPT-4o-mini) to classify patient portal messages using an expert-derived taxonomy on a retrospective corpus; it evaluates model accuracy and stability but does not compare deployment practices.
